text: Date: 01/09/2026 To, The Manager – Listing Department BSE Limited Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers, Dalal Street, Mumbai – 400001 Scrip Code: 531911 Scrip ID: GALAXYAGR Subject: Intimation regarding receipt of Purchase Order aggregating to ₹10 Crores Dear Sir/Madam, Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”), we wish to inform you that Galaxy Agrico Exports Limited (“the Company”) has received a Purchase Order from M/s. Shrynax Trading Private Limited for supply of various agricultural commodities aggregating to approximately ₹10.00 Crores (Rupees Ten Crores only). The order comprises the following agricultural commodities: Sr. No. Product Price per Kg (₹) Quantity (Kg) Order Value (₹) 1 Paddy 250 68,000 1,70,00,000 2 Maize 250 66,000 1,65,00,000 3 Wheat 50 3,20,000 1,60,00,000 4 Bajra 110 1,55,000 1,70,50,000 5 Tur 240 69,000 1,65,60,000 6 Moong 150 1,12,600 1,68,90,000 Total   7,90,600 Kg ₹10,00,00,000 The Purchase Order has been received from M/s. Shrynax Trading Private Limited and relates to the supply of the aforesaid agricultural commodities by the Company. The receipt of this order is expected to contribute to the Company's business operations and revenue. The order is subject to the terms and conditions stipulated therein, including applicable delivery and payment terms. There is no promoter/promoter group interest in M/s. Shrynax Trading Private Limited, and the transaction does not constitute a related party transaction. The Company shall execute the order in accordance with the agreed terms and applicable laws and regulations. The requisite details as required under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations read with the applicable SEBI Circular are provided below:

Annexure-I Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations Particulars Details Name of the entity awarding the order(s)/contract(s) M/s. Shrynax Trading Private Limited Significant terms of order(s)/contract(s) Supply of agricultural commodities including Paddy, Maize, Wheat, Bajra, Tur and Moong, as per the terms and conditions of the Purchase Order. This intimation is being submitted for your information and records. Thanking you, For GALAXY AGRICO EXPORTS LIMITED  ________________________ Mr. Prashant Sudhir Khairnar Director  DIN: 11434708
